description: A chainsaw married to a sword by somebody who had seen a picture of one. The Blackvane signature under the grip is a decal. It does not cut so much as worry at a thing until the thing stops, and the counterfeiters got the ONE part right that matters: it is enormously, stupidly loud, and people run.
name: Blackvane Ripsaw chainblade
